title: 市场冷落AI基建：这家机构却说基本面仍强，三大方向谁被低估
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The way we look at the AI trade is not as one trade, but it's actually split into three different buckets.
segments.zh: 我们看待AI交易的方式不是把它当作单一交易，而是实际上分为三个不同的类别。

segments.en: The AI infrastructure builders, so these are the companies that are building the land, shell, power, and all the kits that go inside the data center.
segments.zh: AI基础设施建造者，即那些建设土地、外壳、电力以及数据中心内部所有套件的公司。

segments.en: We've got the AI enablers, which are the harness providers, the large language models, cybersecurity, governance and control, and then we've got the AI beneficiary.
segments.zh: 我们有AI赋能者，包括硬件提供商、大语言模型、网络安全、治理和控制，然后我们有AI受益者。

segments.en: So the first bucket of the AI builders will remain very positive.
segments.zh: 因此，AI建造者这一类别将保持非常积极。

segments.en: We think the market has already moved away from those and said all these issues that match with reflecting on, you know, that means that trade is over.
segments.zh: 我们认为市场已经远离这些，并表示所有这些匹配的问题都反映了，你知道，这意味着交易已经结束。

segments.en: But we are seeing still plenty of fundamental strength in that particular bucket.
segments.zh: 但我们仍然看到该特定类别有充足的基本面实力。

segments.en: But also, we're seeing opportunities in the AI enablers, whether it's the cyber securities or some of the hyperscalers who are going to be selling that computing
segments.zh: 但同时，我们也在AI赋能者中看到机会，无论是网络安全还是一些超大规模企业，它们将持续出售计算能力，

segments.en: capacity on an ongoing basis, some of the companies that provide the governance and control around using and deploying AI, but also the next leg of the trade,
segments.zh: 一些提供治理和控制围绕使用和部署AI的公司，还有交易的下一阶段，

segments.en: which is the AI beneficiary. Companies will actually use AI to improve their products and services.
segments.zh: 即AI受益者。公司实际上将使用AI来改进他们的产品和服务。
